description: Maps SPOOL product capabilities to the industrial PostgreSQL qualification evidence that proves them. Evidence is in qualification/<runId>/ and verified via sha256sums.

evidenceClasses.LOCAL: Developer-local run (dirty worktree allowed, not release-grade). Produced by `npm run qualify:postgres:ci` on a developer machine.
evidenceClasses.CI: CI PR gate run (clean worktree required for release-grade). Same harness, enforced via SPOOL_COMMIT_SHA and dirty check; releaseGrade = !dirty.
evidenceClasses.QUALIFICATION: Longer profiles (SMALL/MEDIUM) with larger scale and CDC soak, same evidence bundle schema but larger rows/duration.
evidenceClasses.RELEASE: Immutable GitHub release with attached evidence bundle checksums and publication via scripts/publish-release.sh (requires SPOOL_RELEASE_PRIVATE_KEY).

explicitBoundaries.credentialSeparation: PostgreSQL qualification uses a single superuser (spooltest) for setup and target writes for harness simplicity. Least-privilege separation (writer vs reader) is proven separately in mssql-production-conformance via spool_reader (see .github/workflows/ci.yml mssql job and tests/conformance/mssql-*.test.js). PostgreSQL least-privilege reader proof is an explicit non-goal for the CI profile.
explicitBoundaries.evidenceClasses: LOCAL/CI/QUALIFICATION/RELEASE are logical tiers on the same evidence schema (manifest.json releaseGrade flag + dirty check). No separate code paths; promotion is by scale and cleanliness (CI requires clean worktree and commit SHA). LARGE/INDUSTRIAL profiles are defined but not run in PR gate due to duration (documented in profiles.js).
explicitBoundaries.faultInjectorWiring: Fault injectors are wired into the production Postgres target (TARGET_* points) and MigrationRunner (TARGET_* and checkpoint points). CDC/verify/repair deep fault points beyond target commit remain explicit non-goals for CI; they are covered by unit-level fault tests and the conformance suite's faultAfterTargetCommit injection.
